description: This file defines a Prometheus collector for database statistics, specifically for gathering metrics from a *sql.DB instance, including connection counts and closed connection metrics.

classes.name: dbStatsCollector
classes.description: A Prometheus collector that gathers database connection statistics from a *sql.DB instance.

methods.name: NewDBStatsCollector
methods.description: Creates a new instance of dbStatsCollector with metrics descriptions for database stats.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Implements the Describe method for the prometheus.Collector interface, sending metric descriptions to the channel.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Implements the Collect method for the prometheus.Collector interface, collecting current database stats and sending metrics.
